meet-ioverlay.text: A private window that floats over every app. Your notes, a doc, or any website.
Share your screen in Zoom, Meet, or Teams, and the overlay stays out of the share, recordings, and screenshots.
A built-in browser. Adjustable opacity. Click-through. And global shortcuts, on macOS and Windows.
iOverlay. Present with confidence. Get it at i-overlay dot com.

how-to-use.text: Here's how to use iOverlay, in four steps.
Step one. Press the shortcut, and the overlay opens on top of everything.
Step two. Open your notes, a doc, or any website, right inside it.
Step three. Share your screen in Zoom, Meet, or Teams, just like you always do.
Step four. Present. Read your notes, and fade them whenever you like. Viewers only see what's underneath.
Set up in under a minute, at i-overlay dot com.

use-cases.text: iOverlay is made for people who present.
Sales teams keep pricing and next steps in view during demos.
Teachers follow their lesson plan while the class watches.
Support teams keep runbooks open while they help a customer.
And creators read their script while they record their screen.
You see it. They don't. iOverlay, at i-overlay dot com.
